diagnosis.native_behavior: MolGenBench ChemFilterMetric catches chemical-filter exceptions and returns false.
diagnosis.runtime_failure: The isolated endpoint environment lacked Medchem's optional checksum-pinned Lilly 2.1 command-line tools, so every Lilly filter call raised ImportError and every molecule was recorded as a chemical-filter failure.
diagnosis.correction: Install the pinned Lilly runtime and require its three compatible executables before scoring. No threshold, sample, pose, endpoint metric, or gate is changed.
